neighborhoods.name: Channel Islands Harbor

housing: Oxnard's rentals are mostly older single-family houses, apartment complexes and condos. Many farmworker families share homes, so crowded housing is common.

localRules.text: Oxnard's Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Tenant Protection ordinances limit rent increases on covered units to once a year and limit the reasons a landlord can evict.

tenantHelp.name: City of Oxnard Housing Department
tenantHelp.what: rent stabilization questions and overcharge complaints

climate: Look for mold and damp near windows and in bathrooms, since the coastal fog keeps homes humid, and check for salt rust on railings and appliances near the beach.
fact: Oxnard publishes its tenant protection notices in Spanish and Mixteco as well as English.
